_about: The harvest of a carcass (docs/leatherworking-revamp-plan.md §5, §6; contracts §5; lane C), read by rules/harvest.py.
Every number the plan marks proposed lives here so it tunes in play without a code change (owner, 2026-10-08, open point 14).

The roll is the book's skill (Ultimate Wilderness, Trophies and Treasures: Survival for an external part, Heal for an internal one) against DC 15 + the creature's CR; the owner's answer 4 (2026-10-08) adds the craft's level and the skinning kit's +2 to the ROLL, never to the DC.
_branches_note: Which skill takes each branch of the tag grammar (contracts §5.1), and how long one takes. External parts (hide, horn, bone, sinew, scales) are Survival; internal ones (blood, glands, ichor, organs) are Heal (UW). A hide takes `minutes_per_unit` per hide unit, at most `max_minutes` (plan §5.2, proposed). A material document may say `harvest_skill` to override its branch's.
_kit_note: The skinning kit (the leatherworker's field kit carries a skinning knife, `places.has_field_kit(actor, 'leatherworker')`): +2 circumstance, as masterwork tools and the book's taxidermy tools give (PA §1.4).
_carcass_note: How long a carcass can be harvested after death (owner, 2026-10-08, open point 5: 24 hours, Ultimate Wilderness's keeping figure applied to the body).
_tiers_note: A generic hide's tier from its beast's CR (plan §5.4, proposed): CR 0-2 common, 3-5 uncommon, 6-9 rare, 10-14 exotic, 15+ legendary. Each row is the lowest CR of its band.
_grades_note: The harvest game's defect area (0..1, the page reports it; the server grades it) against the UNIDO grades (PA §3.1; plan §5.7): each row is the largest defect area a grade allows. Worse than the last row is a reject: scraps only.
_unplayed_note: The grade a hide lands at while its game has not been played yet (the roll lands it at once, so a reload never loses a taken hide; the game's grade replaces it).
_failure_note: Plan §5.8 (proposed), the Craft rule's shape: a miss by less than `ruin_margin` still takes the part, one grade worse than the game gives and never better than `near_miss_best`; a miss by `ruin_margin` or more ruins it, except that a hide of `ruin_split_units` units or more keeps half (rounded down to whole units ruined) at `ruin_grade`. No retry either way.
_inherit_note: What a generic hide inherits from its beast (plan §5.4; owner answer 6 of 2026-10-08): its highest energy resistance ÷ `resist_divisor` (at least 1; an immunity counts as the tier's ceiling), capped by the tier ceiling; on a hide of `dr_from_tier` or rarer, its highest DR as DR max(1, N ÷ `dr_divisor`)/bypass, capped by the tier ceiling; natural armour `thick_natural` or more makes it thick.
_yield_note: The Yield perk (owner Q6.3: Yield moved to the harvest): the perk's chance per hide taken, rolled by the engine and shown, of `yield_bonus` more units.
_salt_note: Salt costs salt (owner answer 8, 2026-10-08): one measure of curing salt per hide unit at the harvest (the Salt method's own `salt_per_unit`), and one per herbal animal part picked (`animal_part_salt`).
_danger_note: Dangerous skinning (docs/deeds-plan.md §13; owner answers 10 and deeds 6, 2026-10-08): one second check per carcass per danger kind, at the first part taken; exposure only on a miss by `exposed_margin` or more (Ultimate Wilderness, Harvesting Poisons). Poison deals 1d3 doses, each past the first +2 to the save DC (CRB, Poison). Acid and energy go through the hazard op's contact rows (content/rules/hazards.json).
_game_note: The harvest game (UI plan §9: knife depth along the cut line, the real variable a fraction of the hide's thickness; contracts §11.1's `opts.band`). The page reports a 0..1 score and the `defects` area; the server grades the defects (`grade_bands`). `narrow` on rare-and-up beasts, the forge's 'better metal, tighter window'.
_dragon_note: A true dragon's own colour, read from its stat block (never its name): the breath weapon's energy and shape and the printed alignment's good or evil. A true dragon (`dragon senses` printed) tagged with a dragonhide whose row disagrees is refused (the measured red dragon that offered all eleven colours, inventory §0.4).
